'''Colee Quillo''' was a [[human]] who employed the [[Dunn's crew|crew]] of [[slicer]] [[Syreth Dunn]] in the [[Corporate Sector]] to erase his name from the [[Corporate Sector Authority]]'s ledger and erase a enormous [[Currency|debt]] that had left him on the run. He was arrested alongside the crew and placed in a cell with them on the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'' in [[132 BBY]].

Quillo joined the crew when they exploited a flaw in the [[prison ship]]'s [[Variable geometry droid|droid crew]] and [[Prisoner mutiny on the Palwick|escaped]] in an [[escape pod]] in the [[Carlac belt]]. The [[prisoner]]s were allthen quickly recaptured and detained in a holding cell in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Colee Quillo was a [[human]] who came to owe an enormous [[Currency|debt]] during the [[High Republic Era]] and ended up living a life on the run. He hired the services of [[slicer]] [[Syreth Dunn]]'s [[Dunn's crew|crew]] of [[Thief|thieves]] in the [[Corporate Sector]] to wipe his name from the ledger of the [[Corporate Sector Authority]] and clear the debt, but had the misfortune of being in the wrong place at the wrong [[time]] and was arrested with the crew as Dunn's buyer. Due for processing by the [[Detention Task Force]], he was placed on board the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]''<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> in a cell with Dunn and several members of his crew<ref name="Lost Found">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> in [[132 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref>

Quillo and the imprisoned crew heard rumors that the [[meknek]] [[Verosha Aniseya]], who was imprisoned in the cell next to the buyer and Dunn, had [[Death|killed]] a [[Jedi]], a feat unheard of among the other impressed [[prisoner]]s. Dunn attempted to recruit her into a plan to [[Prisoner mutiny on the Palwick|escape]] the [[prison ship]], but she refused, and so the criminals proceeded without her. The [[Hybroid]] [[Rott Mercer]] forced the [[prison ship]] out of [[hyperspace]]<ref name="Lost Found" /> in the [[Carlac belt]] by exploiting a flaw in the [[starship]]'s [[droid]] crew<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and deactivating the [[variable geometry droid]] [[pilot]]s. The [[Unidentified droid warden|warden droid]] was then destroyed by the prisoner<ref name="Lost Found" /> [[Shorwilt]] [[Tor Bez'lin]],<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> who used its [[Limb|arm]] to unlock the cell holding Quillo and the others. Quillo piled into an [[escape pod]] with Dunn and his crew, abandoning Aniseya and the incapacitated prisoner<ref name="Lost Found" /> [[Melo Tolicus]],<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and ejected from the ship.<ref name="Lost Found" />

Quillo was swiftly detained with the crew once again and shared a holding cell with them once more behind a [[force field]] on the detainment level of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. He stood staring through the field as [[Jedi Master]] [[Sol]] passed by and ignored cries from Dunn and Bez'lin claiming that they had done nothing wrong and blaming the escape on Aniseya. Sol then learned the truth of Aniseya's involvement from Tolicus, who had been imprisoned in a cell beside Quillo and the others.<ref name="Lost Found" />

==Personality and traits==
Quinn had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] that, along with his general appearance, was unkempt following his time on the run.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
While imprisoned, Colee Quillo wore black [[Clothing|robes]] and a hidden money [[belt]] where he stored Corporate Sector Authority vouchers that were removed prior to his imprisonment.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colee Quillo appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="Lost Found" /> the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The prison ship and Jedi Temple scenes were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> The character was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
